title: Bold Word Pop
one_liner: Huge all-caps captions with the spoken word lit up, a punch-in every second or two, zero dead air, no music.
best_for: Direct, high-energy teaching to camera: money, mindset, 'here's why' lists. One take, plain background, 15-45 s.

palette.use: the word being spoken, the hook's accent word

pace: 1.2x speed, every pause cut, a hard punch-in change every 0.6-2.3 s (1.00 / 1.18, one 1.30), captions of 1-3 words
signature_moves: All-caps Montserrat Black captions, white with a thick black outline, the spoken word turning yellow and popping 110% -> 100%
Hard punch-ins alternating 100% / 118% on phrase changes and hiding the jump cuts, with ONE 130% on the biggest line
Voice only: no music, no transitions, one whoosh on the big punch-in
references_note: His classic 2022-23 caption look; his current reels look different (see hormozi-2026). The classic recipe comes from public breakdowns cited in SPEC.md.
